recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-8782 unless Patient Care later changes the FamilyMemberHistory absence/negation pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-8782 was a Published FHIR-core Patient Care change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked for documentation distinguishing no known family history from undocumented family history and required a FamilyMemberHistory note pointing to FamilyMemberHistory.condition.code for No Known Problems or no-history-of conditions; patient-level family-history negation was referred to FHIR-8781.
initial_application: Commit bd3f8a7ba5 explicitly tagged #8781/#8782 and added the FamilyMemberHistory notes for List.emptyReason and FamilyMemberHistory.condition.code. The referenced SNOMED CT 160245001 value-set update came from commit afcde8c935 for #8749 in the shared condition-code value set used by FamilyMemberHistory.condition.code.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Current notes still contain the requested condition.code guidance; FamilyMemberHistory.condition.code binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-code; and source/condition/valueset-condition-code.xml includes SNOMED CT 160245001. Later FHIR-17887 added a concrete FamilyMemberHistory negation example and is already audited on the combined branch; later FHIR-43306 was Resolved - No Change and recommends a precoordinated condition.code or CodeableConcept.text rather than a separate negation indicator.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core source already satisfies the applied FHIR-8782 resolution, so the published artifact is an empty no-change audit commit.
